description: This file defines the class SubscriptionCreated, an immutable event class representing the creation of a subscription within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.thingsearch package. It includes methods for instantiation from parameters and JSON, as well as overrides for resource path and string representation.

classes.name: SubscriptionCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class indicating a subscription creation event in the thingsearch signals

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionCreated instance from a subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionCreated instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path associated with this event, here an empty JSON pointer.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SubscriptionCreated with the provided headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to the JSON object; here, nothing is added.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this event object.
